items.rationale: The police report is required under 2.3.3, but translating it to substantiate the claim is expressly excluded by 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f).
Provider working materials and charges ancillary to an excluded translation are excluded by 7.1.8(e)–(f).

The reported robbery is covered, but 7.1.9 limits valuation to the pre-loss specification, and the equivalent watch value is then capped at €2,500 under 4.2.2 and 4.4. The capped watch and cash total €3,000, below the €5,000 away-from-home limit; allocating the single €150 deductible pro rata leaves €2,375 on this line.
The approximately €900 taken in the robbery is valued at face amount under 6.2.4 and capped at €500 under 2.3.2 and 4.2.3. Its pro rata share of the single €150 deductible is €25, leaving €475.
The sunglasses were mislaid separately and were not taken in the robbery, so 2.3.4(a) and 7.1.10 exclude them.
Shipping is expressly excluded by 7.1.8(b), even when billed alongside covered property compensation, and Part 5 provides no applicable exception.
